_comment: Per-device settings for cmd/server. `his-server setup` writes this for you. Every field is optional; values shown are the defaults or examples. Env vars (see .env.example) override fields. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_models: omit to use the 3 built-in models; any listed here replace them (one per tier: weak, mid, strong) — fields as in types.ModelDescriptor
